subject: CRM forecast pulse check — action items to certify commits (ACME Cloud)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Cameron Price <cameron@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CRM forecast pulse check — action items to certify commits (ACME Cloud)

Team,

Quick pulse on the ACME Cloud opportunity ahead of finance close next week. Finance flagged a few gaps in the CRM that are blocking a commit certification:

- Amounts vary across opportunities tied to ACME (some lines show estimated ARR, others show MRR).
- Primary SKU / product mapping is inconsistent ("redwood-hosted" vs "redwood-dedicated" written in free text).
- Next steps field is stale for several contacts; several deals list demo as "next step" but have procurement scheduled.
- Probability percentages look inflated on two large line items (70% vs. observed sales activity).

Requesting a short triage: Marissa, can you run the CRM export and normalize product/SKU names to our canonical list and flag rows where amount differs by >10% across related opps? Karthik, can you validate the probability assignments and set recommended values for finance to review?

I attached the current export from last night. If we can update the records by EOD tomorrow, finance will include these in the Q3 commit.

ACTIONS
- Marissa: normalize SKU, annotate rows that need legal/procurement follow-up (attachment: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_V2.xlsx)
- Karthik: probability sanity check + recommended probability column in CSV
- Ben: I'll follow up with ACME to confirm procurement timing and confirm final amounts

Thanks — short and sharp here.

Ben
Ben Carter

Quick clarifications: the largest line item is tied to a multi-region dedicated deployment (that should be "redwood-dedicated:multi-region" in the SKU column). The smaller add-ons are hosted credits. If it helps, I can put procurement on a quick call with Ben and Karthik tomorrow.

Ben / Karthik / Cameron —

I pulled the CRM export and ran a quick mapping against our canonical product table. Summary below; CSV with annotations attached.

Summary of changes (crm_export_20270911.csv -> crm_export_20270911_annotated.csv):
- Normalized SKU fields: replaced free-text entries with "redwood-dedicated:multi-region", "redwood-hosted:credits", "redwood-private:vpc" where applicable. (see column SKU_CANONICAL)
- Flagged 6 opportunity lines where Amount in CRM != ACV in pipeline export (delta > 10%). Marked those as "review-needed" in REVIEW_REASON column.
- Populated a new NEXT_STEP_RECOMMEND column where the recorded next step was inconsistent with activity. Examples:
  * Opp 8932: had "Schedule demo" but Cameron confirmed procurement call — set to "Procurement call (Cameron/Ben)"
  * Opp 8945: had no next step — set to "Legal SOW review"
- Attached the mutual action plan V2; I've highlighted items procurement will need (SOW timeline, payment terms, IP clauses).

Actionable next steps:
1) Karthik: please review the six "review-needed" rows and drop your probability recommendation in the PROB_RECOMMEND column by EOD today.
2) Ben: schedule 15m call with Cameron + procurement to confirm SOW line items — propose Tue 14 Sep, 10:00 PT?
3) I'll upload the annotated CSV to the ACME HubSpot record and tag finance once Karthik's probabilities are in.

I'll iterate quickly once we have Karthik's input.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager

Got it — reviewed the six flagged rows. Notes below (see PROB_RECOMMEND column in annotated CSV):

- Opp 8932: observed contract language gap but procurement call scheduled; set probability from 70% -> 55% (recommend monitoring SOW approval).
- Opp 8945: legal open items, no procurement engagement; set 40% -> 20%.
- Opp 8959: demo complete, technical fit confirmed, set 60% -> 65% (increase based on good signals).
- Opp 8971: multi-region deployment, procurement committed to budget, set 75% -> 80% (confirm signature timeline).
- Remaining two: conservative adjustments to reflect outstanding legal/Risk reviews.

I'll upload the annotated CSV to HubSpot and leave a short note on the record. Ben — lock in the Tue 10:00 PT slot if that works for you and I'll join.

— Karthik
